the task of online vehicle localization at intersections using a single stereo camera.

there is no dataset that is suitable for benchmarking vision based localization at intersections.
the KITTI datasets, and in particular the ones that we kept, are the only available datasets that we know of, that are suitable for benchmarking the task of localization at intersections.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created a dataset that is suitable for benchmarking visionbased localization at intersections, and we have evaluated the existing datasets for this purpose.

the dataset is a set of 20 sequences of 10 seconds of stereo video, each sequence with a different camera configuration and a different driving path, taken with a road vehicle approaching an intersection, together with a reliable measure for the vehicle position in each video frame.
we have collected a dataset of sequences taken from our own vehicle, and we are in the process of collecting sequences from other vehicles.

we have to be careful in selecting the dataset for the task of localization at intersections.
the KITTI sequences are not sufficient as a benchmarking dataset for vision-based localization at road intersections, and that we need to collect our own sequences.
